scope: schema: packages/db/prisma/schema/*.prisma — 196 models gain a `/// @dpf` documentation line (lifecycle class, retention disposition, sensitivity, categories, regulated scope, owner, steward, time axis); no column, type, index, relation, enum or migration changes; lifecycle: scripts/portal-migrate-boot.sh runs packages/db/scripts/apply-model-metadata-comments.ts (COMMENT ON TABLE only); retention sweep (apps/web/lib/operate/retention) now BUILDS its purge policies and retained set from the catalog declarations instead of a TypeScript list; PURGE_POLICIES / RETAINED_DATASETS / RETENTION_CATEGORIES, scripts/check-retention-enrollment.mjs + allowlist and scripts/stewardship-exemptions.txt are deleted
rationale: EP-A33A5C61 slice 4 (BI-D9F158AF), founder direction 2026-09-08: declare governance metadata once, on the model, and carry it in the Postgres catalog instead of in four parallel TypeScript homes (table-classification.ts, the govern/data asset registry, retention/policies.ts, stewardship-exemptions.txt). This change is metadata-only: Prisma `///` documentation comments and idempotent COMMENT ON TABLE statements. No physical data shape changes, no rows are created, moved, masked or deleted, and no reader behaviour changes in this slice — the retention sweep still reads policies.ts until slice 4d switches it to pg_catalog. The manifest contract's per-model asset/field resolution is therefore not applicable: every value written here is COPIED from the existing registries by apps/web/scripts/seed-model-metadata-tags.ts (the diff is reviewable one line per model), and the 430 models with no determinable disposition are left untagged in a shrink-only baseline rather than guessed. 4d-i (same PR): the sweep reads the same declarations back from pg_catalog (schema-file fallback when the catalog has no dpf: comments yet). The executed windows are byte-for-byte the ones the deleted hand list carried — the codemod copied them — and retention.test.ts now asserts, against the real schema, that every behavioural override names a purgeable model, that regulated records stay retained (invoice/payment/bill ≥ 7y, initiative pins permanent) and that the ToolExecution partitions cover every audit class. Industry floors are re-keyed onto a 3-value bucket derived from the DataCategory tag (audit/chat/telemetry); every floor that existed still applies, the only collapse is that audit-log and security-audit (both 7y) became one bucket.
compensatingControl: scripts/check-model-metadata-tags.mjs (registered in the source policy guards) fails CI on any tag that violates the closed vocabularies, any purge window on a non-purgeable class, any purge window without a time axis, any retained record without a cited basis, and any NEW persistent model that carries no tag; the untagged baseline can only shrink. The boot-time applier is warn-only (the portal never refuses to start over metadata) and never overwrites a hand-written table comment. packages/db/src/model-metadata.test.ts covers parse/format/catalog round-trips; the applier was dry-run against the development install before merge. The sweep logs and falls back to the shipped schema files if the catalog carries no declarations, so a database the applier has not reached never runs with zero policies. Dry-run remains available from the Scheduled Jobs page before the first live run.
